unresolved_conflicts.description: Two author snapshots advertise spec3002 but different metadata hashes. Neither is accepted. Establish raw-byte/hash encoding and capture provenance before deciding why.

Inspected IVesting.sol constant ...0902 conflicts with external precompile address construction ...09020000. Target registration must be proven; use source-backed external candidate 0x0000000000000000000000000000000009020000 only after qualification.

candidate_fixture.warning: Amounts require target minimum/capacity/ratio verification. Deadlines and active-schedule buffer chosen during later authorized setup. No live identifiers or signable bytes. Supersedes the earlier UX 40/60/1000-block fixture and all synthetic fixed dates.

gates.title: Exact network and runtime identity
gates.current_basis: Published spec number and source pins do not identify a deployed implementation.
required_evidence: Accepted genesis, runtime code identity, source/build relationship, raw metadata bytes and hash
Reconcile divergent published metadata hashes without assuming a normalization
All native call, event, storage and signed-extension shapes; configured block-number providers
SHA256 of exact SCALE metadata bytes with no hex-string normalization; independently retained raw capture and block/context provenance
Runtime :code BLAKE2-256 and decoder/type artifact digest checked independently of SDK specVersion caches, including reconnect and at(B)
Separate execution, post-state and runtime-API contexts; no metadata merge solely because spec3002 agrees

gates.title: Reserve and hold composition
gates.current_basis: Conditional source composition establishes a risk, not target behavior.
required_evidence: Proxy Currency, Revive Currency, Balances instance and hold backing configuration at accepted runtime
Canonical Pure creation deposit payer and every later reserve adjustment
Existential/liveness, lock/freeze, hold/release and deposit-constant behavior
Typed split ledger: recorded proxy D, creator-funded historical D, P-funded increment f, individual holds, named/other liabilities, aggregate reserved and unexplained delta
Do not count total_balance_on_hold again or place contract-held storage liabilities in P holds; only intact source-qualified provenance permits exact refund expectation
refusal_rules: Block unexplained history, unknown holds or deposit constants changed since creation

Missing persistent mapping blocks grant escrow funding/payout and dependent Revive business calls; native top-up and explicit mapping are prerequisites, not circularly blocked outputs

gates.title: Controlled single-round business context
gates.current_basis: Pinned Vestry does not enforce expected round/evidence nonce. This proposed release boundary permits only a controlled two-milestone single-round demonstrator.
required_evidence: Exactly two native-token milestones and two direct mapped reviewers; metrics disabled; grant originally h(P)
Round zero and complete relevant event/attempt/proposal history before each new submission/approval
First submission per milestone and intended evidence; no confirmed external change request or conflicting executed business intent
Explicit distinction between client review expiry, native proposal lifetime and direct transaction mortality
Recovery actions separately assessed after scope breach; historical proof preserved
refusal_rules: ScopeBreached is sticky for the grant under this profile
Missing or uncertain history -> ReconciliationRequired, not proof of absence
No assertion that local scope controls prevent external execution or revoke stale proposals
Recurring/asynchronous real-grant release blocked until separate on-chain freshness design and qualification

full_reset.reason: Under inspected shared Balances composition full reset rematerializes proxy deposit on P after unreserving across P-held mapping backing. Atomicity does not repair successful accounting mismatch.

variable_definitions.PD_factor: ProxyDepositFactor in qualified native units; not funder actor F
variable_definitions.H: Recognized P-held reasoned liabilities sharing the inspected aggregate reserved backing. Excludes contract-held storage contributions merely funded by P. Canonical fixture has no unexplained unrelated reserves.

gate_evaluation.rule: Evaluate gate evidence components by operation stage. A gate reference identifies an obligation domain, not a requirement that the operation already produced its own effects. Detailed preconditions in operations.json govern before signing; its produces_evidence_for_gate_refs are after-finality outputs.
gate_evaluation.profile_components: Exact source/configuration/decoder/wallet capability must be accepted before any dependent signing.
gate_evaluation.checkpoint_components: Actual authority, mapping when required by the action, liquidity, deadlines and existing proposal are freshly read for that action. Past acceptance does not imply current state.
gate_evaluation.setup_outputs: Recipient funding, Pure existence, actual mapping and grant initialization are outputs of their setup actions; source semantics and donor/payer affordability must be accepted beforehand.
gate_evaluation.readiness: Pre-sign identity, legitimacy and signer capability checks precede execution. A+D removal and milestone1 receipts are produced evidence, not prerequisites to executing those exact operations.
gate_evaluation.continuity: Q-CONTINUITY is evaluated after the required attributed M1 submission. It never gates that submission by requiring prior continuity success.
gate_evaluation.release: Q-USABILITY is product-release evidence, not a native protocol precondition. Read-only evidence gathering may proceed with unknowns explicitly marked.
gate_evaluation.status: All target evidence components remain unqualified in this research.
gate_evaluation.scope: Q-GRANT-SCOPE creation checks policy before grant exists and verifies real round0 after finality. Exact native cancellation and optional direct vest_other after independent historical continuity proof have separate predicates. External reclaim/proxied vest are observation-only; scope breach never widens authority.

deferred_outside_bounded_integration: Hackathon schedule/eligibility not re-decided; earlier deadline research remains separate and is not an execution gate for this dossier.
